tasks.title: Stop stale supervisor status/source_ref regressions
acceptance: A task with a newer pushed PR head cannot be overwritten by stale dispatch sync metadata.
ai-status.json and .orchestrator/state.json source_ref/status mirrors converge after supervisor tick.
Regression test covers #4273-style 141d06ec -> f6d340ff rollback and fails before the fix.

tasks.title: Make missing worker processes become bounded retry/reopen outcomes
acceptance: A worker marked missing during boot reconciliation cannot leave a task pretending to progress.
The supervisor records a bounded retry, reopen, or terminal failure with task id, run id, provider, and reason.
Regression test covers missing closeout worker for review_approved task.

tasks.title: Bind fleet reviewer decisions to GitHub review gates
acceptance: A governed approve/reopen for a PR-backed task either submits a GitHub review or records an explicit branch-policy-recognized alternative.
Internal activity approval cannot be treated as sufficient when GitHub latestReviews is empty.
Regression test covers #4269-style internal review_approved with GitHub REVIEW_REQUIRED.
